title: 10-Day Istanbul, Athens & Cairo Capitals Tour
metaDescription: Discover Istanbul, Athens and Cairo in 10 days on a focused three-capital journey featuring imperial landmarks, classical heritage and the Pyramids of Giza.
breadcrumb: Explore Our Travel Destinations & Multi-Country Tours

summary:
The 10-Day Turkey, Greece & Egypt Tour connects three Mediterranean destinations through their major historical capitals and archaeological sites. Begin in Istanbul with its Byzantine and Ottoman heritage before flying to Athens and visiting the Acropolis. A day trip to Delphi adds classical Greece beyond the capital, followed by a flight to Cairo for the final stage, including the Pyramids of Giza. The route is designed to cover three countries without adding island stays or a Nile cruise.
International flights between Turkey, Greece and Egypt link the itinerary. Selected 4-star hotels, breakfast, selected lunches, professional local guides, airport transfers, entrance fees and scheduled sightseeing are included.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.text:
Upon arrival at Istanbul Airport (IST or SAW), meet our representative and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in is available after 14:00. The rest of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Oldcity Walking Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, enjoy a guided tour of Istanbul. Visit the historic Hippodrome of Constantinople, including the Egyptian Obelisk, Serpentine Column, and Fountain of Wilhelm II. Continue to the iconic Blue Mosque and the magnificent Hagia Sophia. After lunch, explore the atmospheric Basilica Cistern, famous for its ancient columns and underground beauty. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Bosphorus cruise and Asia Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit the historic Spice Bazaar, one of the city’s most colorful and lively markets. Continue with a scenic cruise along the Bosphorus, sailing between Europe and Asia while enjoying views of palaces, mosques, and waterfront mansions. Cross the Bosphorus Bridge to Çamlıca Hill for panoramic views over the city, then visit the elegant Beylerbeyi Palace, the former summer residence of Ottoman sultans. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Flight from Istanbul to Athens
itinerary.text:
Breakfast. Check out and transfer to Istanbul Airport for your flight to Athens (16:00–17:25).
Upon arrival, meet and transfer to your hotel. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Delphi Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel in Athens. Drive through the region of Boeotia via Thebes, Livadeia, and the mountain village of Arachova. Arrive at Delphi and visit the famous Temple of Apollo, the Treasury of the Athenians, and the Delphi Archaeological Museum. Return to Athens for overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Saronic Island Cruise of Hydra, Poros & Aegina
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel in Athens. Transfer to Port of Piraeus for a full-day Saronic Islands cruise. Visit the islands of Hydra, Poros, and Aegina with free time to explore each island. Lunch will be served on board during the cruise. Return to Athens in the evening. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Athens City Tour then flight to Cairo
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel in Athens. Enjoy a half-day city tour including the Acropolis of Athens, the iconic Parthenon, and the Acropolis Museum, along with panoramic highlights of the city. Afterwards, transfer to the airport for your flight to Cairo. Upon arrival, meet and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Memphis, Giza Pyramids & Sphinx
itinerary.text: Meet your guide and visit Memphis, the ancient capital of Egypt, and see the impressive statue of Ramesses II. Continue to Saqqara to explore the famous Pyramid of Djoser. Afterwards, visit the legendary Giza pyramid complex and admire the iconic Great Sphinx of Giza. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Egyptian Museum, Old Cairo & Khalily Bazaar Tour
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel in Cairo. Visit the impressive Grand Egyptian Museum and the historic Cairo Citadel, including the beautiful Mosque of Muhammad Ali. Continue to explore Old Cairo with visits to the The Hanging Church and Saints Sergius and Bacchus Church (Abu Serga Church). End the day at the famous Khan el-Khalili Bazaar. Overnight in Cairo.

Check-out and transfer to Cairo International Airport according to your flight schedule

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 10-Day Cairo, Athens & Istanbul Tour?
faqs.a: The 10-Day Cairo, Athens & Istanbul Tour covers three of the Mediterranean region's most iconic cities: Istanbul, Athens, and Cairo. This itinerary combines Ottoman heritage, ancient Greek civilization, and the wonders of ancient Egypt, offering an unforgettable cultural journey across three fascinating countries. The tour runs for 9 nights and 10 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 10-Day Cairo, Athens & Istanbul Tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €2,275 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, guided sightseeing tours, selected meals, airport and hotel transfers, domestic transportation, and two domestic flights. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel category.

faqs.q: Are flights included in the package?
faqs.a: Yes, two domestic flights are included within the itinerary. These flights help reduce travel time and allow travelers to maximize their sightseeing experience. International flights between countries are not included unless specifically stated.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes accommodation in carefully selected hotels in Istanbul, Athens, and Cairo. Daily breakfast is included, and additional meals may be provided according to the itinerary. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, quality, and convenient locations.

Yes, professional English-speaking guides accompany the scheduled sightseeing tours in each destination. Your guides will provide fascinating insights into the history, culture, architecture, and traditions of Turkey, Greece, and Egypt.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors. It covers the major highlights of Istanbul, Athens, and Cairo, providing an excellent introduction to three of the world's most historically significant cities.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is easy to moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through historical sites, museums, archaeological landmarks, and city centers. Most visitors with average fitness levels can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Istanbul, Athens, and Cairo?
faqs.a: Highlights include the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Grand Bazaar, and Bosphorus in Istanbul; the Acropolis and Parthenon in Athens; and the Pyramids of Giza, the Great Sphinx, and the Egyptian Museum in Cairo. Each city offers a unique blend of history, culture, and local traditions.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 10-Day Cairo, Athens & Istanbul Tour?
faqs.a: Free cancellation is available up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms, airline conditions, and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is strongly recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Can the 10-Day Cairo, Athens & Istanbul Tour be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade hotel categories, include additional destinations such as Cappadocia, Santorini, Alexandria, or Luxor, or modify the itinerary to suit your travel interests. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
